documented_expected_behaviour: Gather all required information efficiently and in an easy-to-use manner.
Transform the input into comprehensive requirements.
Resolve team/brand, dates/location, content responsibilities, platform/tools, design requirement level, campaign responsibilities, success metrics, collaboration behaviours, and screening evidence.
initial_manager_statement: We need a Marketing Intern for summer. They should be creative and good with social media. Maybe some design skills? They'll work with the team on TikTok stuff and help with campaigns. Should be fun to work with.

turns.manager_message: We need a Marketing Intern for summer. They should be creative and good with social media. Maybe some design skills? They'll work with the team on TikTok stuff and help with campaigns. Should be fun to work with.

next_question.question: What specific TikTok and campaign tasks will the intern be responsible for during the summer?

turns.manager_message: They'll script and film short TikTok videos with the team, then I handle final editing and posting myself. On campaigns, they'll help coordinate assets between the design and social teams, not run campaigns solo.

next_question.question: What observable collaborative behaviours do you expect from the intern when working with the team?

turns.manager_message: They should speak up in brainstorms even as the newest person, and take feedback on a script rewrite without getting defensive.

next_question.question: Which social-media platforms, tasks, and experience level should the intern have?

turns.manager_message: TikTok and Instagram Reels only. On both, they will do scripting and filming with the team; there is no editing or publishing responsibility because I own those steps. Entry-level experience from a student project or personal channel is enough.

next_question.question: What observable creative contribution should the intern make—for example, proposing TikTok/Reels content ideas during brainstorming?

turns.manager_message: Each week the intern should bring two audience-relevant TikTok or Reels concepts to the brainstorm, explain the hook, and turn one approved concept into a script draft. That is the observable creative contribution; we are not screening for a vague creative personality.

next_question.question: Does “TikTok or Reels” mean the intern may choose either platform each week, or should they create concepts for both platforms?

turns.manager_message: Both platforms: the weekly concepts can be adapted across TikTok and Instagram Reels, and the scope on each is scripting and filming only, with no editing or publishing responsibility.

next_question.question: Are there any required tools, equipment, or on-camera expectations for filming?

turns.manager_message: They can film on a company phone with the supplied tripod and microphone; no specialist camera gear is required. They may appear on camera when a concept calls for it, but being on camera is not a hiring requirement.

next_question.question: Are there any accessibility, consent, or brand-guideline requirements for an intern appearing on camera?

turns.manager_message: On-camera appearance is always voluntary with explicit consent; declining has no hiring or performance consequence. Any appearance must follow the Consumer Products brand guide and approved script, and we will accommodate accessibility needs.

next_question.question: Who approves the scripts and provides the Consumer Products brand guide before filming?

turns.manager_message: The Brand Marketing Lead provides the Consumer Products brand guide before work starts and approves every script before filming.

next_question.question: What observable, job-relevant collaborative behaviours should the intern demonstrate when working with the Brand Marketing Lead?

turns.manager_message: In the Consumer Products Brand Marketing team, the intern should share draft scripts with the Brand Marketing Lead at least one business day before filming, ask specific questions about feedback, revise the draft, and confirm approval before using it.

next_question.question: Does the Brand Marketing Lead have final authority to approve scripts before filming?

turns.manager_message: Yes. The Brand Marketing Lead has final authority to approve or reject every script before filming.

next_question.question: What feedback topics must the intern clarify, and what makes a clarification question sufficiently specific?

turns.manager_message: They must clarify three topics: whether the hook fits the target audience, whether any claim conflicts with the brand guide, and which exact line or shot needs revision. A sufficiently specific question names the draft section and asks for a decision or concrete change.

next_question.question: What is the expected frequency or volume of script drafts the intern should prepare during the internship?

turns.manager_message: One approved script draft per week across TikTok and Instagram Reels, so eight approved scripts over the eight-week internship.

next_question.question: Are the eight weekly approved scripts distributed between TikTok and Instagram Reels in a specific way?

turns.manager_message: Four approved scripts for TikTok and four for Instagram Reels. The internship runs December 1 through January 23, on-site in Auckland, 40 hours a week, in the Consumer Products Brand Marketing team reporting to the Brand Marketing Lead. Basic Canva edits for a slide or caption graphic are optional and learnable in the first two weeks; no prior design proficiency is required.

next_question.question: Which calendar year do the December 1 through January 23 internship dates refer to?
